plan_guidance.Starter: Run CAT-00, CAT-01, CAT-02, CAT-03, CAT-04, and authorized product-state checks in CAT-09/CAT-11. Physical categories CAT-05 through CAT-08 and shared physical TiFlash evidence are excluded. Unsupported product evidence is N/A with a reason.
plan_guidance.Essential: Use the same logical-cluster boundary as Starter. Attempt keyspace-scoped provisioned capacity, available RU, read/write maximum RU, consumption and rc_wait corroboration when exposed. Never use parent-pool physical evidence.
plan_guidance.Premium: Use the same logical-cluster boundary. Attempt logical-cluster RU/RCU and KV request-wait queueing evidence when exposed. Shared-pool coprocessor wait, TiKV/PD CPU, nodes, storage and topology are excluded.
plan_guidance.Dedicated: Run tenant SQL and logical storage plus capability-gated full-stack CAT-05 through CAT-11. Every physical rule still requires route, ownership, label, permission, version, unit and source validation.
plan_guidance.BYOC: Use the Dedicated logical/full-stack category set, but treat cloud-provider and infrastructure evidence as capability-gated because metric ownership and provider integrations vary by deployment.
plan_guidance.Unknown: Default-deny. Only safe metadata required to explain routing failure may be emitted.

profile_boundaries: Default health evaluates R checks and C checks after capability validation.
component_deep_dive evaluates only the explicitly requested component/category and does not silently expand scope.
SQL Top-N checks are D checks and do not determine cluster Health by rank.
N/A lowers confidence instead of severity.
Snapshot evidence may supplement but never replace the required observation window.
A check affects Health only when evidence, unit, denominator, scope, threshold or baseline, and persistence semantics are valid.
